roleZh: 将外部直流电容或母线接入 P、N 层。
roleEn: Connects an external DC link or capacitor to the P and N layers.
featuresZh: 正负端子相邻布置有利于缩小回路面积；连接电阻与扭矩需验证。
featuresEn: Adjacent positive and negative terminals help reduce loop area; joint resistance and torque need verification.
materialEn: Copper, with optional tin or nickel plating.
